SELECT ID
FROM ECOLI_DATA
WHERE GENOTYPE = 3
ORDER BY ID ASC

SELECT ch.ID
FROM ECOLI_DATA ch
LEFT JOIN ECOLI_DATA pa ON ch.PARENT_ID = pa.ID
LEFT JOIN ECOLI_DATA gpa ON pa.PARENT_ID = gpa.ID
WHERE gpa.ID is not null
ORDER BY ch.ID ASC

SELECT ch.ID
FROM ECOLI_DATA ch
LEFT JOIN ECOLI_DATA pa ON ch.PARENT_ID = pa.ID
LEFT JOIN ECOLI_DATA gpa ON pa.PARENT_ID = gpa.ID
WHERE gpa.ID is not null and gpa.PARENT_ID is null
ORDER BY ch.ID ASC
